whatIsIt.eli5: Volume knobs that also remember where along the rows and columns things are.
whatIsIt.simple: Pools along the height and along the width separately, mixes them, and produces one gate per row and one per column for every channel.
whatIsIt.engineer: pool_h, pool_w → cat → Conv1×1(→mip) + BN + h-swish → split → Conv1×1 (h), Conv1×1 (w) → σ → x·a_h·a_w.

whyExists.eli5: Rows of crops and lines of weeds have a direction; this keeps it.
whyExists.simple: Keeps positional information that global pooling (SE) throws away, which helps locate long or thin objects.

eli5: Summarize each row and each column.
Turn rows and columns up or down.
simple: Average along the width (one value per row) and along the height (one per column).
Two 1×1 Convs give row gates and column gates.
